🗡️ Woopire Duels

A separate turn-based squad game, tucked inside Woopire Defense
🪙0
🍖0
🍗0

Speed determines turn order across both full squads (faster units act more often, on a shared Action Value queue), and on its turn a unit picks a move — Basic Attack, a Skill, or (once its Energy bar is full) an Ultimate — and a target; no positioning or range, any living unit can strike any foe. Your squad carries its HP/energy/cooldowns straight into each stage's next wave, only the enemy side resets between waves. Uses its own stats and its own save — entirely separate from a unit's Stages/Challenge kit.

Duel Chapters

Every unit you've summoned across Woopire Defense — Common through Mythic — reforged with its own Duel stat block. Entirely separate from its Stages/Challenge tower stats. Equip up to 4 as your Duel Squad below. Passives are on the way; every unit has an open slot for one.
